---
title: "Dashboard Grid One Off"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(wesanderson)
library(fontawesome)
library(ggtext)
library(showtext)
library(formattable)
library(DT)
library(flextable)

dashboard <- read_csv("data/solano_dashboard.csv") %>%
  filter(countyname == "Solano", reportingyear == 2023) %>%
  mutate(
    color = as_factor(color),
    color = fct_relevel(color, "0", "1", "2", "3", "4", "5"),
    indicator_color = case_when(
      rtype == "S" & color == 0 ~ "#D3D3D3",
      rtype == "S" & color == 1 ~ "#FF6347",
      rtype == "S" & color == 2 ~ "#FFA500",
      rtype == "S" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFF00",
      rtype == "S" & color == 4 ~ "#3CB371",
      rtype == "S" & color == 5 ~ "#1E90FF",
      rtype == "D" & color == 1 ~ "#CD5C5C",
      rtype == "D" & color == 2 ~ "#FFAF70",
      rtype == "D" & color == 3 ~ "#FFFACD",
      rtype == "D" & color == 4 ~ "#90EE90",
      rtype == "D" & color == 5 ~ "#87CEFA",
      .default = "#737373"
    ),
    leaname = if_else(is.na(charter_flag), districtname, schoolname),
    change = if_else(is.na(change), "", paste(change)),
    change_arrow = if_else(
      indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "ELPI", "graduation", "college/career"),
      case_match(
        changelevel, # improvement means up
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      ),
      case_match(
        changelevel, # improvement means down
        0 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf068;</span>",
        5 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf063;</span>",
        4 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf078;</span>",
        3 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf7a4;</span>",
        2 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf077;</span>",
        1 ~ "<span style='font-family:fa-solid;'>&#xf062;</span>",
        .default = "<span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</span>"
      )
    ),
    indicator = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(indicator),
      "ELA",
      "Math",
      "ELPI",
      "absenteeism",
      "graduation",
      "suspension",
      "college/career",
      "science"
    ),
    leaname = fct_relevel(
      as_factor(leaname),
      "Solano County Office of Education",
      "Benicia Unified",
      "Dixon Unified",
      "Fairfield-Suisun Unified",
      "Travis Unified",
      "Vacaville Unified",
      "Vallejo City Unified",
      "Buckingham Collegiate Charter Academy",
      "Caliber: ChangeMakers Academy",
      "Elite Public",
      "Ernest Kimme Charter Academy",
      "Dixon Montessori Charter",
      "Fairmont Charter Elementary",
      "Griffin Academy High",
      "Kairos Public",
      "Mare Island Technology Academy",
      "MIT Academy",
      "MIT Griffin Academy Middle",
      "Vallejo Charter"
    ),
    lealetter = case_match(
      leaname,
      "Solano County Office of Education" ~ "District A",
      "Benicia Unified" ~ "District B",
      "Dixon Unified" ~ "District C",
      "Fairfield-Suisun Unified" ~ "District D",
      "Travis Unified" ~ "District E",
      "Vacaville Unified" ~ "District F",
      "Vallejo City Unified" ~ "District G",
      "Buckingham Collegiate Charter Academy" ~ "Charter A",
      "Caliber: ChangeMakers Academy" ~ "Charter B",
      "Elite Public" ~ "Charter C",
      "Ernest Kimme Charter Academy" ~ "Charter D",
      "Dixon Montessori Charter" ~ "Charter E",
      "Fairmont Charter Elementary" ~ "Charter F",
      "Griffin Academy High" ~ "Charter G",
      "Kairos Public" ~ "Charter H",
      "Mare Island Technology Academy" ~ "Charter I",
      "MIT Academy" ~ "Charter J",
      "MIT Griffin Academy Middle" ~ "Charter K",
      "Vallejo Charter" ~ "Charter L"
    )
  )

status_colors <- c(
  "lightgrey",
  "tomato",
  "orange",
  "yellow",
  "mediumseagreen",
  "dodgerblue",
  "darkgrey"
)

font_add('fa-solid', 'fonts/fa-solid-900.ttf')

```

## California School Dashboard Summary One-off Grid

::: column-page-inset-right
![](dashboard-cell-key-CDE-change.png){fig-align="right"}
:::

```{r all_students}
#| echo: false
#| column: body

showtext_auto()

dashboard %>%
  filter(
    student_group_long == "All students",
    rtype == "D" | (rtype == "S" & charter_flag == "Y")
  ) %>%
  arrange(rtype) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_richtext(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    mapping = aes(
      label = if_else(
        indicator %in% c("ELA", "Math", "science"),
        paste(currstatus, change_arrow, change),
        paste0(currstatus, "% ", change_arrow, " ", change)
      ),
      fill = color
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE,
    text.color = "black",
    color = "darkgrey",
    label.size = 0.8,
    size = 5.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, drop = FALSE, na.value = "white") +
  facet_grid(lealetter ~ indicator, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_markdown(
      size = 14,
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.7,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    strip.clip = "off",
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "lines"), # Reduced horizontal spacing between facets
    panel.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "lines"), # Reduced vertical spacing between facets
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5) # Provide a little breathing room around the entire plot
  )

showtext_auto(FALSE)
```
